scope: C775: conditional owned enum payload transferred into a growable container must clear arm cleanup only after completed storage.
decisions: Managed push completes container storage, then removes transferred owned literal sources; RemoveLocal clears a retained payload flag.

Specialized SLG push omitted the existing completed-transfer marker used by regular calls and aggregate constructors. A conditional match payload therefore remained owned and was dropped despite the stored copy.

Call the existing semantic-move marker at the shared successful append boundary, after element/data/length/capacity are formed and before the optional owner-return path. Borrow-only branches never execute the marker.
Do not change caller source ownership, clone payloads, or bypass match cleanup.
